classification_source: Slurm cluster fabric metadata frozen before any Phase39 measurement: `scontrol show topology` InfiniBand switch tree and per-node Slurm feature tags captured at 2026-08-15T06:22:59+00:00. rack_id is the node's InfiniBand leaf switch; network_domain is the core switch above that leaf. No measured timing was consulted.
fabric_notes: nvidia-a51 B200 cluster, NDR InfiniBand three-level tree (root a51 -> ibccore* -> ibcleaf*). L2 replicas sit inside a single leaf switch (ibcleaf03-03 and ibcleaf03-04 respectively); L3 replicas cross from ibcleaf03-03 to ibcleaf03-04 through core ibccore03. Each host exposes 8x NVIDIA B200 with intra-node NV18 NVLink and per-GPU RDMA NICs ['mlx5_10', 'mlx5_13', 'mlx5_14', 'mlx5_15', 'mlx5_4', 'mlx5_7', 'mlx5_8', 'mlx5_9'].
